text:
marta: AM async standup — quick heads-up: planning a short livestream walkthrough at 11:30 PST to go over the latest keyscan results and remediation plan. posting my what I did / blockers / today here. ping if you can't make it.

sam: Sounds good. Can we also include the IAM policy drift alerts? I fixed one role last night, will bring that up during the walkthrough.

kai: I won't be able to join live, please record. Today's blocker: can't repro CVE-2026-xyz in staging — repro steps are failing for me.

lina: Working on automation for KMS rotation dry run, pushed branch `kms/rotation-dryrun-2026` — need a quick CR review, @marta @sam.

security-bot: Automated KeyScan complete: 3 high findings (old keys in prod vault), 4 medium (unused service principals). Report: https://internal.redwood/kscan/17777 

marta: thx @security-bot. Plan for highs: rotate keys for `svc-prod-ml`, `svc-analytics`, and revoke `svc-old-backup` by EOD. @ops-oncall can you schedule the window?

ops-oncall: scheduled maintenance window 16:00-16:30 UTC. I'll own the rotation steps. Tag me ~10m before you start.

sam: CR review done for `kms/rotation-dryrun-2026`, left 2 minor comments. Also opened PR #412 for IAM policy fixes — will link during walkthrough.

marta: kai — can you paste the failing repro logs here (inline if short) so we can triage quickly?

kai: quick snippet:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:05Z error: token exchange failed: invalid scope
at exchange_token (/srv/app/auth.go:312)
caused_by: missing STAGING_TOKEN_SCOPE env
```
I think it's an env var issue in the staging pod.

lina: I'll add a guard in the dryrun script. Quick diff:
```
- export KMS_KEY=""
+ export KMS_KEY=${KMS_KEY:?"KMS_KEY missing"}
```
Pushing the change and will re-run the dryrun.

marta: OK. Today: 1) walkthrough keyscan at 11:30 (will record), 2) coordinate rotations with ops, 3) follow up on CRs and QA. Blockers: waiting on ops window for prod rotations; need QA signoff for `svc-analytics` revoke.

sam: I'll do QA smoke for `svc-analytics` after the rotation. Ping me once ops starts.

lina: :thumbsup: I'll queue the dryrun and tag the PR when ready.

security-bot: Reminder: Compliance snapshot due tomorrow 12:00 PST — please verify control evidence for KMS rotations.

marta: noted. I'll upload evidence after rotation. Thanks, team.
